## Context / Problem

Three agents on 2026-08-05 reported contradictory answers to whether ticking an Acceptance Criteria checkbox invalidates a plan-review attestation. The empirical behavior is settled: checkbox state is normalized out of the material fingerprint, so ticking boxes is attestation-safe. The defect is diagnostic: stale-attestation messages used a fixed, partly-fictional component list (`description/AC/file_impact/children`) and did not say what actually changed.

Operator-approved scope: wherever rebar reports an attestation error, it must say WHAT CHANGED. No gate outcome changes are allowed: edits may only change reason strings for already-failing branches or add deterministic diagnostic manifest data. If a proposed change would alter a verdict, threshold, branch condition, or add an external dependency, stop and escalate.

## Re-verified findings / root cause

- The material basis is a composite sha256 over `ticket_id`, `description`, `file_impact`, `children`, plus `file_impact_scope` when declared none. AC item text lives inside `description`; there is no separate `AC` basis key.
- Checkbox state is normalized (`[x]` / `[X]` -> `[ ]`) before hashing, so a tick-only edit does not stale an attestation. Item text remains material.
- A composite hash is one-way; a stale-material branch cannot name the changed component unless the signed record carries prior per-component fingerprints. Legacy manifests without that data must degrade honestly.
- Related `children` material is derived from other tickets' parent/relationship state, not just this ticket's event log; existing `plan-material-pin:` lines can still recover signed child id sets for legacy degradation.
- Current origin/main already contains most of the intended 94a3 implementation. This ticket finishes and verifies the diagnostic contract, including the AC that the misleading fixed-list literal no longer remains in `src/`.

Defect origin: bug 330c (`330c-1c85-5bd4-48b5`, commit `9ba1e90e3ccc`) correctly changed the behavior by normalizing checkbox state but left the old generic staleness explanations without component-level diagnostics. This is an unmet diagnostic obligation/regression against the gate message contract, not a gate behavior defect.

## Repair plan

1. Keep `pass1.py` untouched (near the 800-line cap). Put per-component hashing and explanations in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/material_diff.py`, single-sourced with the composite basis.
2. Ensure `build_manifest` emits deterministic additive `material-part:` component records and `manifest_material_parts()` parses them leniently so malformed diagnostics cannot change verdicts.
3. Ensure `compute_validity` uses `explain_material_change()` for both plan-review and completion-verifier `stale-material` reasons, and that `stale-reopened` names the signed/reopened timestamps.
4. Ensure claim-gate unsigned advice names both remedies: `review-plan` for no review and `sign-review` for a passed review whose signature failed to persist.
5. Ensure all attestation refusal surfaces either forward the computed reason or preserve equivalent diagnostics: generation, resign, completion child closure, CLI sign-aborted rendering, close-gate/claim-gate/status paths.
6. Remove the exact misleading fixed-list literal from runtime source while preserving historical explanation in docs/tests without recreating the diagnostic message.
7. Document in `docs/plan-review-gate.md` that ticking an AC checkbox is attestation-safe and that stale-material reasons name changed components.

## File impact

- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/material_diff.py` — per-component hashing/explainer and removal of the exact misleading literal from source prose.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py` — additive material-part emit/parse behavior.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py` — component-named stale-material reasons and timestamped stale-reopened.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest_gate.py` — actionable unsigned message and accurate verdict vocabulary.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/generation.py` — named material/dependency staleness messages.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py` — named material staleness messages.
- `src/rebar/llm/completion.py` — child closure validity reason forwarding.
- `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py` — sign-aborted reason/remedy rendering.
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md` — checkbox-safety and component-diff documentation.
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py` — regression tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `material_components(ctx)` covers exactly the composite material basis keys; changing one basis component changes only that component hash.
- [x] `build_manifest` emits sorted additive `material-part` records and `manifest_material_parts()` round-trips them; old manifests parse to `{}`.
- [x] `stale-material` reasons name only the differing component(s) with compact magnitude and never report the fixed list `description/AC/file_impact/children`; grep proves that literal is gone from `src/`.
- [x] Tick-only AC checkbox edits leave `compute_validity(...)["verdict"] == "certified"`.
- [x] Pre-330c legacy attestations over unchanged material remain certified; un-grandfatherable legacy attestations say the changed component cannot be named instead of inventing one.
- [x] `stale-reopened` names both timestamps and unsigned claim-gate advice names both `review-plan` and `sign-review` remedies.
- [x] `plan_review_sign_aborted` rendering includes its reason (for example `store-read-failure`) and does not advise `sign-review` for store-read failures.
- [x] Dependency-material drift messages from generation name the changed dependency ticket ids, matching resign behavior.
- [x] No gate outcomes change: touched stale branches keep their existing `(valid, verdict)` pairs, and targeted plan-review suites pass.
- [x] `docs/plan-review-gate.md` states plainly that ticking an AC checkbox is attestation-safe.

## Verification plan

- RED: strengthen `tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py::test_the_fixed_enumeration_is_gone_from_the_source_tree` to require zero occurrences of the fixed-list literal in `src/`; confirm it fails before the source cleanup.
- GREEN: run `pytest -q tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py tests/unit/test_legacy_material_grandfather_96d1.py tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py tests/unit/test_plan_material_pins.py`.
- Replicate: run a focused in-process script over `material_fingerprint` / `compute_validity` proving tick-only edits certify and description/file_impact/children edits produce named `stale-material` reasons.
- Safety: run repo grep for the exact misleading literal under `src/`, docs grep for the checkbox-safety statement, and `make lint` / relevant type/test gates before Gerrit push.
